text: 10-month-old boy. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. The mother notes that the wheezing exacerbates when the child is crying, feeding, and when his neck is flexed. Additionally, there are instances where the child vomits after feeding.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the stridor improve when the infant's neck is extended or when lying prone, and has he had any recent respiratory infections? REQUEST TEST: Laryngoscopy

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the stridor persist in both inspiration and expiration, or is it primarily inspiratory, and has a neck X-ray or CT scan been performed to evaluate the tracheal structure? REQUEST TEST: Neck_CT_Scan

speaker: Doctor
text: Since laryngoscopy and static imaging were normal, I need to rule out dynamic airway collapse. I will request a dynamic fluoroscopy or CT during inspiration and expiration to check for tracheomalacia or vascular compression. REQUEST TEST: Dynamic_Fluoroscopy
